legend: ALI-SAIRO has a string s%%ZSMJ0%% of length n%%ZSMJ1%% containing only digit numbers from '0' to '9'.
Let's define di (1≤i<n)%%ZSMJ2%% as the number whose decimal representation is sisi+1%%ZSMJ3%%.
In one operation, you can choose i%%ZSMJ8%% and j(1≤i≤j≤n)%%ZSMJ9%%; (i, j%%ZSMJ10%% don't have to be adjacent), and swap si%%ZSMJ11%% and sj%%ZSMJ12%%.
Find the minimum number of operations required to minimize F(s)%%ZSMJ13%%, and determine the minimum value of F(s)%%ZSMJ14%%.
input: The first line contains one integer t(1≤t≤103)%%ZSMJ15%% — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains a single integer n: (1≤n≤106)%%ZSMJ16%% — length of the string.
The second line of each test case contains a string s%%ZSMJ17%% of length n%%ZSMJ18%%.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n%%ZSMJ19%% over all test cases doesn't exceed 106%%ZSMJ20%%.
output: For each testcase, output the minimum number of operations required to minimize F(s)%%ZSMJ21%%, and determine the minimum value of F(s)%%ZSMJ22%%.
